He had a goal and three assists, his first four-point game since January 2025.

Konecny is the kind of player Flyers fans have always loved: fast, feisty and at his best when a game gets chaotic. It was the fourth overtime goal of his career, which ties him for the eighth most in team history.

The comeback itself gave fans something to celebrate. It was only the seventh time the Flyers have won after trailing by three goals in the third period, and the first since March 2021. Cam York scored twice, Tyson Foerster and Jamie Drysdale added goals, and Konecny had a hand in much of it.

His track record backs it up. Konecny scored 27 goals and 68 points last season and has spent his whole career in Philadelphia, which picked him 24th overall in 2015. In our analysis, that loyalty is a big reason his jersey stays popular with the fan base.
